detail.longDescription: Claude Code built the admin console for my apidays workshop demo and every check it ran passed - type check, lint, build, direct FGA queries, all green. My first real click found five bugs, one per layer: a session claim silently dropped by an SDK's own refresh handler, a chat loop that stops after one tool call, an authorisation model with nothing seeded to check against, and more. https:// tobytes.com/a/69 # auth0 # fga # mcp # AIagents
